note: Nine DEC-* IDs mirror current P1_DECISIONS.md; separate CHANGE-* decisions summarize approved overlays. Both supplement but never replace the seven baseline documents. Historical alias CHANGE-ARCH-001/DEC-IMP-ARCH-001 superseded in the derived cache by DEC-ARCH-001.

decisions.title: Workflow code identity
rules: workflow_states.code is canonical logic identity
workflow_states.name is display data only
bootstrap name equals code

decisions.title: Privileged Authorization Group bootstrap
rules: group code SYSTEM_ADMIN
name System Admin
status ACTIVE
description NULL
explicit approved 92-action snapshot
no automatic future-action grants
membership provision by Shield user ID CLI/deployment
membership only
no runtime bypass

decisions.title: Canonical GROUP root bootstrap
rules: code GROUP_DINKTECH
name Dinktech Group
description Tập đoàn Dinktech
type GROUP
status ACTIVE
parent NULL
company/address/location/effective fields NULL
conflicting existing GROUP root blocks
no Company bootstrap

decisions.title: Multi-level Product Group hierarchy
rules: adjacency-list persistence
nullable parent_id self FK
arbitrary depth
global Product Group code uniqueness
no self-parent or direct/indirect cycle
valid reparenting
no status cascade
effective ACTIVE ancestor path for new Product selection
existing Product references preserved
shared GROUP-level master
hierarchy mutation serialized by product-group-tree
no closure/nested-set/materialized-path/helper table
no Product Company Usage Scope

decisions.title: Canonical Employee gender catalog
rules: employees.gender canonical stored/API values are MALE, FEMALE, OTHER, or NULL
NULL means not specified and UNSPECIFIED is not a valid code
localized labels are presentation-only: Nam / Male, Nữ / Female, Khác / Other, Chưa khai báo / Not specified
keep employees.gender VARCHAR(20); do not add a lookup table or migration

decisions.title: Resource Domain authorization scope normalization
rules: canonical Resource Domain values are SYSTEM, MASTER, ORGANIZATION; COMPANY is not a Resource Domain
resources.domain is required and canonical existing Resource domain is immutable in normal runtime
SYSTEM and MASTER authorize at GROUP
ORGANIZATION resolves through an explicit registered authoritative Resource resolver
missing/unknown domain or unresolved ORGANIZATION context fails closed
client context and actor Primary Assignment cannot override or complete Resource authorization scope
P1-API-020 is blocked until authority sync, domain migration/seed, resolver verification, and API-010 Contact owner-scope regression are complete

decisions.title: Display Settings presentation-only foundation and early Gate 8 UI checkpoint
rules: Display Settings are presentation-only and never business, authorization, workflow, pricing, effective-date, numbering, import, or calculation authority
server scopes are SYSTEM and ORGANIZATION only; no server USER or COMPANY pseudo-scope
reuse CodeIgniter Settings persistence and the approved configuration_audit_events sink; do not invent a generic settings table
display_setting is an ORGANIZATION Resource with view/edit actions through canonical AuthorizationService/PBAC
Gate 7A foundation is P1-DSP-001..005; P1-DSP-006 and P1-DSP-090 execute as the early Gate 8 checkpoint
P1-FE-003 and feature UI P1-FE-010..080 remain blocked until P1-DSP-090 is DONE

decisions.title: Canonical LifecycleTargetAdapter
rules: LifecycleService must use explicitly registered target adapter, lock/re-read, resolve transition before authorization, and commit exact state change with audit
No generic Resource Instance/state table, client-as-authority state/context, or System Admin special path

decisions.title: Product/Pricing modular-monolith boundaries
rules: Product module owns group/UOM/Product/role/structural COMBO and its numbering integration
Pricing module owns Price List/resolution and monetary COMBO allocation
Product never depends on Pricing; Pricing consumes stable public Product contracts, not concrete Product repositories
Import remains a separate shared-infrastructure / Product-specific implementation boundary; do not expand its scope implicitly

decisions.title: Unique normalized Policy scope
rules: One Policy per organization_id + resource_id + normalized_state + participant_type + participant_ref_id
Generated normalized_state_id uses zero for state_id NULL; duplicate scope returns 409 POLICY_SCOPE_ALREADY_EXISTS
Reconcile only proven-equivalent legacy duplicates with precedence ABSOLUTE_DENY > ALLOW > DENY; block otherwise

decisions.title: Canonical Shield User mutation
rules: Shield only for User/Password, never local ERP identity persistence
Dedicated user.reset_password permission for admin reset; separate identity,state,membership,direct-ALLOW mutations
Group labels never infer rights and direct user permission does not bypass PBAC/ABSOLUTE_DENY

decisions.title: Authenticated Base Permission UX snapshot
rules: Additive data.user.base_permissions on authenticated login/me/profile DTO, no new standalone route or persistence
Sorted catalog-backed Base Permission set is a UX hint only, never final authorization; conservative stale/missing behavior

decisions.title: Policy Scope uniqueness additive retrofit
rules: Forward-only generated-column unique key for normalized Policy scope; ensure 409 duplicate including concurrent attempts
Complete Policy Action/Effect mutation atomic; duplicate reconciliation must stop if equivalence not proven
Independent scoped change-control work, not an extra task in 107-task registry

decisions.title: Shield User mutation additive retrofit
rules: Shield identity only; dedicated User create/edit/state/password reset/direct-allow operations and PBAC guard
Dedicated user.reset_password action, no new local ERP password persistence
Independent scoped change-control work, not an extra task in 107-task registry

decisions.title: Resource collection bulk Action representation
decisions.approved_by: Approved change control v1.1 in filename v1.0
rules: GET /api/v1/resources?include=actions optional additive representation without altering bare collection
Nested actions are loaded in one authorized bulk query; no /api/v1/resource-actions route
Documentation-only overlay paired with Shield User change implementation, not new task
